players.bio: Adam James Smith (born 29 April 1991) is an English footballer who plays for Bournemouth. He has also represented England at under-21 level. He is a defender who is economical with possession. Smith is a product of the Tottenham Hotspur youth academy. On 23 September 2010, Smith joined Bournemouth on a month loan deal.

Adrien Lilian Gaëtan Truffert (born 20 November 2001) is a French professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Premier League club Bournemouth. Early life Adrien Truffert was born on 20 November 2001 in Liège, Belgium to French parents Laurence and Jean-Christophe Truffert. When Adrien was six months old, his family moved to Southampton because his father was a laboratory director.
Alex Jay Scott (born 21 August 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club AFC Bournemouth.

Álvaro Daniel Rodríguez Muñoz (born 14 July 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Premier League club Bournemouth. Born in Spain, he has represented both Spain and Uruguay at youth international level.

Amine Adli (Arabic: أَمِين عَدْلِيّ; born 10 May 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder, winger, or forward for Premier League club Bournemouth. Born in France, he plays for the Morocco national team.
Bafodé Diakité is a French professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Bournemouth.
Ben Gannon Doak (born 11 November 2005) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a right winger or attacking midfielder for Premier League club Bournemouth and the Scotland national team.
Daniel David Jebbison (born 13 August 2003) is a Canadian professional soccer player who plays as a forward for Premier League club Bournemouth and the Canada national team.
David Robert Brooks (born 8 July 1997) is a professional footballer who plays as a right winger or attacking midfielder for Premier League club Bournemouth, and the Wales national team.
Đorđe Petrović (born 8 October 1999) is a Serbian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Ligue 1 club Strasbourg, on loan from Premier League side Chelsea and the Serbia national team.

Eli Junior Éric Anatole Rainha Kroupi (born 23 June 2006) is a French professional footballer who plays as a forward for Premier League club Bournemouth. Early life Born in Lorient, Morbihan, Kroupi is the son of former Ivory Coast footballer Éli Kroupi. His mother is of Portuguese descent.

Francisco Evanilson de Lima Barbosa (born 6 October 1999), commonly known as Evanilson, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Premier League club Bournemouth and the Brazil national team.

Fraser Gerard Forster (born 17 March 1988) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Bournemouth. Forster started his career with Newcastle United and had brief loan spells with Stockport County and Bristol Rovers. He then spent a successful season on loan at Norwich City, helping the club win the League One title and promotion to the Championship.
James Clayton Hill (born 10 January 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Bournemouth.

Juan Luis Sánchez Velasco (born 15 August 2003), commonly known as Juanlu Sánchez or simply Juanlu, is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a right-back or right wing-back for Premier League club Bournemouth.
Julián Vicente Araujo Zúñiga (born 13 August 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Premier League club Bournemouth.
Julio César Soler Barreto (born 16 February 2005) is a professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Premier League club Bournemouth.
Justin Dean Kluivert (born 5 May 1999) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or winger for Premier League club Bournemouth and the Netherlands national team.

Lewis John Cook (born 3 February 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club AFC Bournemouth and the English national team. Cook is a graduate of Leeds United's academy. He has represented England at various youth levels.

Marco Rose (born 11 September 1976) is a German professional football manager and a former player who is currently the head coach of Premier League club Bournemouth. He coached Mainz 05's second team, then Lokomotive Leipzig, before going through the ranks at Red Bull Salzburg.

Marcus Joseph Tavernier (born 22 March 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Bournemouth. Tavernier has also represented England at U19 and U20 level. Club career Middlesbrough Tavernier was born in Leeds.

Maximillian James Aarons (born 4 January 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Premier League club Bournemouth. A Norwich City youth product, Aarons joined the academy in 2016 at the age of sixteen. He went on to sign for the club professionally two years later in 2018, and quickly became a regular player for the side in the Championship.
Michele Di Gregorio (born 27 July 1997) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Bournemouth, on loan from Juventus.

Ryan Christie (born 22 February 1995) is a Scottish footballer who plays for AFC Bournemouth and the Scotland national team. He began his career with Inverness Caledonian Thistle before joining Celtic in 2015, and had two spells on loan at Aberdeen. He has also represented the Scotland under-21 and full national teams.

Tyler Shaan Adams (born February 14, 1999) is an American professional soccer player who plays for Premier League club Bournemouth and captains the United States national team. Primarily a midfielder, he is capable of playing as a full-back on either side of the defense or midfield.

Veljko Milosavljević (Serbian Cyrillic: Вељко Милосављевић; born 28 June 2007) is a Serbian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Bournemouth and the Serbia national team.
